envelope.description: Sam picks up his phone and opens the text message from Bristol Plumbing.
Sam reads the text message from Bristol Plumbing asking him to confirm the Thursday 8am slot by 6pm today.
Sam types and sends a reply text message to Bristol Plumbing confirming the Thursday 8am slot.
Sam's reply text message is sent from his phone and transmitted over the mobile network.

data.reason: To check if the message was delivered or if there is any delivery notification.
